name: typst-pdf-editor
description: This is a vs codium plugin that allows one to read PDFs and add comments using typst

scripts.build: cd typst-previewer && yarn build && cp dist/index.html ../dist/preview.html && cd .. && tsc -p .
scripts.install:
codium --uninstall-extension chris.typst-pdf-editor && codium --install-extension ./typst-pdf-editor-0.0.1.vsix && echo "



Installed Extension, now Control Shift P + Developer: Reload window

"
